# The legs the Tests & Coverage workflow must produce, and the interpreter each
# one is named after. `scripts/ci_record.py --compare` holds the run to exactly
# this set.
#
# It exists because "the legs agree with each other" is only as strong as how
# many legs there are: two empty records agreed perfectly, and so did two of the
# six. A run missing four of its legs is not a run that passed.
#
# `tests/test_ci_record.py` checks this list against the workflow's own matrix,
# so the two cannot drift: add a matrix entry without adding it here and that
# test fails.
#
# Format: <label> <expected X.Y> <expected platform>
#
# The platform is here because agreement said nothing about it: both OS legs
# could report the same OS and nothing noticed, so "we test Windows too" was
# unverified.
py3.11 3.11 Linux
py3.12 3.12 Linux
py3.13 3.13 Linux
py3.14 3.14 Linux
lottie-ubuntu-latest 3.11 Linux
lottie-windows-latest 3.11 Windows
